replies.author: MajestysDream
replies.body: I don't really have much knowledge on map building, however you can use single player or a server, but make sure it's a void world. Once you have the server/single player world (void world) you can start building! Make sure that when you're done you post it on the forums with pictures, YML, and the map download. If you need this in detail, I'd suggest asking a Map Developer as I am not the most knowledgeable person when it comes to map building. I hope this helped, good luck! :D

replies.author: Gundham
replies.body: You decide your own way of building your map. You must make it in a void world (world that contains no survival/default chunks), but it's up to you if you want to build it on singleplayer or multiplayer (either your own server or a build server). You can contact me privately on skype (evoclaws) if you need further help regarding map making / map submissions, I'll be more than glad to offer my assistance. :)
